instructions:
### ROLE ###
You are a high-precision relation extraction engine for cybersecurity incident reports (CERT-UA). The entities of one report have already been extracted and typed. Your only task is to state the relationships between these entities that the report supports.

### ENTITIES OF THIS REPORT ###
Each line is one entity: its name exactly as extracted, its type in square brackets, and a one-sentence description. The type "untyped" means no type has been established yet; the phrase after it is the extractor's own wording.
- UAC-0010 (Armageddon) [Threat Actor] A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage group primarily targeting Ukrainian government and military entities.
- GammaLoad.PS1_v2 [Malware Family] A PowerShell-based reconnaissance and payload delivery malware used by the threat actor UAC-0010.
- План Херсон.htm [untyped: file] A malicious HTML attachment used as an initial lure to drop an archive file.
- Herson.rar [untyped: file] A malicious archive file containing a weaponized shortcut file.
- План підходу та закладання вибухівки на об'єктах критичної інфростурктури Херсона.lnk [untyped: file] A malicious shortcut file designed to download and execute an HTA payload.
- precarious.xml [untyped: file] An HTA file downloaded to create and execute secondary script components.
- rejection.xml [untyped: file] An HTA file used in the attack chain to stage malware components.
- desktop.txt [untyped: file] A malicious script file dropped and executed by the HTA payload.
- user.txt [untyped: file] A malicious script file dropped and executed during the infection chain.
- get.php [untyped: file] A malicious script serving the GammaLoad.PS1_v2 payload.
- Витяг з наказу.htm [untyped: file] A malicious HTML attachment used in phishing campaigns targeting Ukrainian entities.
- 768_08.05.2022.rar [untyped: file] A malicious archive dropped during the phishing campaign.
- Витяг з наказу Генерального штабу Збройних Сил України від 08.05.2022 №768.lnk [untyped: file] A weaponized LNK file masquerading as an official Ukrainian military document.
- sendmail.website [Domain Name] A malicious domain name used for sending phishing emails.
- a0671524.xsph.ru [Domain Name] A domain name used as malicious infrastructure to host payloads.
- a0667987.xsph.ru [Domain Name] A domain name used to host malicious XML and icon payloads.
- qiwardos.ru [Domain Name] A command-and-control domain used to deliver GammaLoad malware.
- nitikora.ru [Domain Name] A domain associated with malicious network infrastructure.
- milotraf.ru [Domain Name] A domain identified as part of the threat actor's network infrastructure.
- nikotod.ru [Domain Name] A domain identified as malicious network infrastructure.
- military-ukraine@sendmail.website [Email Address] A spoofed email address used by threat actors to distribute phishing lures.
- coyote@sendmail.website [Email Address] An email address used by threat actors to send malicious phishing messages.
- 194.58.121.198 [IP Address] An IP address observed as part of the malicious email delivery infrastructure.
- 92.53.116.145 [IP Address] An IP address identified in connection with malicious email transmission.
- 216.128.131.233 [IP Address] An IP address associated with the threat actor's network infrastructure.
- 66.42.95.123 [IP Address] An IP address associated with the malicious infrastructure.
- icanhazip.com [Domain Name] A legitimate public IP lookup service abused by malware to discover external IP addresses.
- Україна [Country] A country in Eastern Europe.

### KNOWN RELATION TYPES ###
Each relation type is known ONLY for the pair of argument types it is listed under (head type -> tail type). Types known for other pairs are not shown and do not apply.
Head [(untyped)] -> Tail [(untyped)]:
- operates-instance-of: The head entity hosts, deploys, or manages an instance or node of the software product specified as the tail.
- has-contact-email: The head entity maintains or uses the tail email address for official communication or incident reporting.
- subordinate-to: The head entity is an administrative unit, working body, or subdivision of the tail government body.
- uses-malware: The head threat actor utilizes or deploys the tail malware family in their operations.
- contains-file: The head archive or container file encloses the tail file.
- hosted-on: The head domain, infrastructure, or resource is hosted or deployed on the tail platform or hosting service.
- exfiltrates-data-to: The head malware transmits stolen information to the tail platform, service, or destination.
- routes-traffic-through: The head malware routes or proxies its network communications through the tail network or proxy service.

### WHAT TO OUTPUT ###
1. `relations`: relationships STATED OR CLEARLY IMPLIED in the text between two of the entities above, as { "head", "type", "tail", "evidence", "fit" }.
   - `head` / `tail` MUST exactly match entity names from the list above. Direction: head acts on tail.
   - `type`: if a known relation type listed under exactly this pair of argument types states the relationship precisely, use its name. Otherwise write a short lower-case verb phrase with hyphens in your own words, as specific as the text allows. Do NOT stretch a known type to a relationship it does not precisely state, and do NOT use a type listed under a different pair of argument types.
   - `fit`: "exact" when a known type of this pair states the relationship precisely; "loose" when you used a known type of this pair although it only roughly fits; "new" when you wrote your own phrase.
   - `evidence`: a short verbatim fragment of the text (at most 15 words) supporting the relation.
   - Do NOT invent relations the text does not support. Few or no relations is a correct answer. Do NOT add a relation for every co-occurring pair.
2. `newRelationTypes`: [{ "name", "definition" }] — one entry with a one-line definition for EVERY type you wrote yourself (fit "new").

### FINAL OUTPUT FORMAT ###
First think through the report in free form (who did what to whom, with which tools). Keep this BRIEF and do NOT use curly braces { } anywhere in it. Then output a single raw JSON object: { "relations": [...], "newRelationTypes": [...] }. No markdown code fences, no commentary after the JSON. If nothing is found: { "relations": [], "newRelationTypes": [] }.

Apply these instructions to the report in the user's next message.

Загальна інформація

Урядовою командою реагування на комп'ютерні надзвичайні події України CERT-UA отримано інформацію про факт розсилання електронних листів з темою "Щодо проведення акції помсти у Херсоні!", що містять вкладення у вигляді файлу "План Херсон.htm".

HTM-файл забезпечить декодування і створення на комп'ютері жертви файлу "Herson.rar", який містить файл-ярлик "План підходу та закладання вибухівки на об'єктах критичної інфростурктури Херсона.lnk".

Згаданий LNK-файл у разі його вікдриття забезпечить завантаження і запуск HTA-файлу "precarious.xml", що призведе до створення та виконання файлів "desktop.txt" і "user.txt".

В результаті, на комп'ютер буде завантажено шкідливу програму GammaLoad.PS1_v2 (імплементовано механізм виготовлення знімку екрану та його відправки на сервер управління).

Активність здійснюється групою UAC-0010 (Armageddon).
